purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0071 in the gauge arena: the family symmetry group is the full S3 (all six family permutations, uniform multiplicity) from the order-24 stabilizer of the preferred unit inside the order-168 automorphism group, with a Klein four-group kernel, refining the order-three result.
